在魔能里，你能进行试验并组合至多五种元素，创造出各种法术。 由于有上千种元素组合可以供你使用，所以试验尤为重要。 在施放元素之前，你需要一根法杖。现在，从武器架上取一把。

Magicka is a game where you can experiment and combine up to 5 Elements to create Spells. Experimentation is important, as there are thousands of combinations at your disposal. But to conjure any Elements at all, you first need a staff. Go get one from the weapon rack.
点击武器架，获得法杖和剑。
To obtain a staff and a sword, interact with the weapons rack.
看来你掉下来时受了伤，既然你有了法杖，就能给自己治疗。 用右摇杆选择一个生命元素。
It seems that you've taken some damage from your fall. Now that you have a staff, you can heal yourself. Conjure a Life element by using the Right Stick.
来你掉下来时受了伤，既然你有了法杖，就能给自己治疗。 用W键按一个生命元素。

It seems that you've taken some damage from your fall. Now that you have a staff, you can heal yourself. Conjure a Life element by pressing W.
很好！现在你的法术输入槽里有了一个生命元素，利用“对自己施放”来将法术施放到自己身上。
Nice! Now that you have a Life Element in your Spellbar, cast it on yourself using Cast Self.
很好！现在你的法术输入槽里有了一个生命元素，利用鼠标中键来将法术施放到自己身上。

真棒！你痊愈了！ 现在用剑砍断挡住房间出口的绳索。 按“攻击”使用剑。
Awesome! You're all healed up! Now use your sword to cut the rope that is blocking the way out of the room. Press Attack to use your sword.
真棒！你痊愈了！ 现在用剑砍断挡住房间出口的绳索。 按下SHIFT键和鼠标左键使用武器。
Awesome! Your all healed up! Now use your sword to cut the rope that is blocking the way out of the room. Hold down SHIFT and press the Left Mouse Button to use your sword.
选择三个大地元素，然后按住“RT键”来积蓄法术的力量。 当法术充满能量后，对着木板施放。
Conjure 3 Earth Elements, then hold the Right Trigger to charge the Force of your spell. When the spell is fully charged, release it against the wooden boards.
按三次大地元素，然后按住鼠标右键来积蓄法术的力量。 当法术充满能量后，对着木板施放。
Conjure 3 Earth Elements, then hold the Right Mouse Button to charge the Force of your spell. When the spell is fully charged, release it against the wooden boards.
做得很好。现在你必须点亮火坛，激发桥的伸展。 选一个火焰元素，对着火坛喷射。 长按“施放”可以一直维持喷射法术。
Good work. Now you have to light the torch, which will extend the bridge. Conjure a Fire element and spray the torch. Spray spells can be sustained by holding down the Cast button.
在裂缝对面有另一个火把，但用喷射法术够不着。 组合大地元素和火焰元素，创造出一个火球，作为投射物扔出去。 试着用火球击中火炬。

On the other side of the chasm there's another torch, but it's too far away to reach with a Spray Spell. Combine Earth and Fire to create a Fireball. This can then be cast in the same manner as the Earth projectile. Try to hit the torch with a Fireball.
这扇门的机关需要电力来启动。 选一个闪电元素，施放到发电机上。
The mechanism to this door requires electricity to be activated. Conjure a Lightning Element and cast it on the generator.
你的衣服湿透了！众所周知湿着玩电不是个好主意。 你必须先烘干自己，选一个火焰元素，施放在自己身上。 注意：身体干燥的时候最好别这么干。

That water made your robes all wet, and as everyone knows, dabbling with electricity while you're wet is a really bad idea. You must first dry yourself by conjuring Fire and casting it on yourself. Note: Be sure not to try this trick if you're already dry.
烘干自己之后，你需要同时给两个发电机供电。 最简单的方法是施放区域法术。 按住“LT键”以施放区域法术。
Now that you're dry, you have to electrify both generators at the same time. The easiest way to do this is to cast an Area Spell. Do this by pressing and holding the Left Trigger.
烘干自己之后，你需要同时给两个发电机供电。 最简单的方法是施放区域法术。 按住SHIFT和鼠标右键以施放区域法术。

Now that you're dry, you have to electrify both generators at the same time. The easiest way to do this is to cast an Area Spell. Do this by holding Shift and pressing and holding the Right Mouse Button.
下一扇门的发电机离得太远，单纯的闪电没法够着。 而大地是不导电的，与闪电属性相反的，二者没法组合. 所以为了增加闪电的距离，在法术输入槽添加一个奥术元素。

The generator for the next door is too far away to be reached with just Lightning, and you can't combine Lightning and Earth because they are Opposites to each other. To extend the reach of Lightning, add an Arcane element to your spell.
酒窖被淹没了！ 众所周知，巫师都是旱鸭子。别担心， 雪一般的寒冷不仅能够使敌人减速，也能用来使液体结冰。
The cellar is flooded! And as everyone knows, Wizards can't swim. Don't worry, Cold is not only good for slowing down your enemies, but can also be used to Freeze bodies of liquid.
用来给城堡取暖的炉子已经点上了， 看上去路被堵住了，唯一的去路是从炉子上通过。 然而因为巫师十分“易燃”，所以用水把火扑灭才是明智的。

The furnaces that keep the castle warm are on, and the path appears to be blocked. It seems that the only way around is to go through the furnace, and as Wizards are highly flammable, it would be wise to use Water to put the fire out.
很久以前，一个老巫师觉得安装这个粉碎机是个好主意。 但实际证明这个粉碎机没什么用。 看，书架上有本上古流传下来的魔法技能书！ 也许它能帮你穿过粉碎机……

A long time ago, an old Wizard thought it would be a good idea to have this masher installed. It hasn't proven to be that useful though. But look, there's an old Tome of Magick in that bookshelf! Maybe it can help you get past the masher...
你应该能使用加速魔法通过粉碎机。 用十字键滚动魔法列表， 当加速魔法被选择时，所需要的元素会显示在魔法条的背景上。 按顺序选出所需要的元素后，按“魔法键”施放法术。

You should be able to use Haste to pass the masher. Navigate through your list of Magicks with the D-pad. When Haste is selected, the Elements you need will be shown in the background of your Spellbar. When you have conjured the Elements indicated, you can cast it by pressing the Magick button.
你应该能使用加速魔法通过粉碎机。 用鼠标滚轮滚动魔法列表， 当加速魔法被选择时，所需要的元素会显示在魔法条的背景上。 按顺序按出所需要的元素后，按空格键施放法术。

You should be able to use Haste to pass the masher. Navigate through your list of Magicks with the Scroll Wheel. When Haste is selected, the Elements you need will be shown in the background of your Spellbar. When you have conjured the Elements indicated, you can cast the Magick by pressing the Spacebar.
小地精都是胆小鬼，但他们被逼到困境时会奋起反击。 当法术输入槽空着的时候，用RT键或LT键来施放推击。 隧道尽头的门锁上了，当入侵的小地精们全部被消灭后才能打开。

Imps are cowards, but they will attack if cornered. When your spellbar is empty, you can use either the Right or Left trigger to perform a Push. The door at the end of this tunnel has been closed, and will only open when all the intruding Imps have been taken care of.

Checkpoints restore your health and revive your fallen comrades. If you die you will restart at the latest checkpoint that you activated.
